w: Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was weighed and honored with tulsi leaves. More than 8,000 devotees and well-wishers attended this festival. In his blessings Swamishri said, "... Whatever little we do for God is never an empty act. He returns your service and devotion in one way or another. Sometimes He may take time in responding, but even in that lies our good..."
Swamishri left Bochasan at 9.57 a.m., and due to a flat tyre, arrived late in Bharuch at 12.35 p.m. After a cursory look at the construction work of the new mandir Swamishri went to his residence.
In the evening, 104 devotees from Karjan and other towns had walked (padyatra) 40 kms for Swamishri’s darshan. Swamishri blessed them by showering rose petals.
In the evening, Swamishri performed the sthambharopan (placing of a pillar) ceremony of the mandir in Bharuch.

Tulsi - Tula Utsav : Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was weighed and honored with tulsi leaves. After the preliminary speeches Swamishri worshipped Harikrishna Maharaj amidst the chanting of Vedic mantras by the sadhus. Then the 5,500 well-wishers placed their tulsi leaves on the weighing pan and offered their devotion.

In his blessings, Swamishri said, "The region of Bharuch is holy because it is on the banks of the River Narmada. And on such a holy land, a beautiful mandir -a moral and cultural center - is taking shape... "Whatever little we do for God is never an empty act. He returns your service and devotion in one way or another. Sometimes He may take time in responding, but even in that lies our good. God comes to redeem and do good for all. It is because of our nature we feel that, ‘Why does God do this to me?’ But even in that He desires for your good...
" The Tulsi-Tula festival was attended by 8,000 devotees and well-wishers.

Dr. K.M. Acharya of Jamnagar, a renowned doctor treating leprosy patients, came for Swamishri's darshan and blessings. He was impressed by Swamishri's visit to Jamnagar last year and reflected, "After your blessings my service to society has become very successful. Even today those patients (leprosy) lovingly remember you. Who would touch leprosy patients? But your personal touch and blessings has impressed them. Swami, we heal the physical wounds and afflictions whereas you heal their mental wounds and afflictions… The leprosy patients to whom you had presented bicycles and sewing machines are now earning their own bread. They have become self-sufficient and gained a lot of confidence."

Swamishri celebrated Shri Hari Jayanti - Bhagwan Swaminarayan's 221st birthday festival at the mandir. The festival commenced at 7.00 pm with dhun and bhajans. The program was interlaced with speeches, bhajans and a drama. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, elaborating upon the life and work of Bhagwan Swaminarayan.

At 10:10pm, Swamishri, senior sadhus and the entire congregation performed the birthday celebration arti. The festive ambience was enhanced by the silver plated cradle in which Thakorji had been placed, boys dressed as Brahma, Vishnu and Mahesh, children adorned as devas, Brahmins, and rishis awating at Dharmadeva's house for the birth of Ghanshyam. Swamishri then gently pulled the cradle to and fro with the resounding singing of 'Sona na Bor Zule Dharmakishore...' The costumed children danced with joy in celebration of the Lord's birth. The celebration concluded with Jai's of Bhagwan Swaminarayan.

The mandir in Sarangpur is a seminary for sadhus. Here the sadhus are trained spiritually and taught Sanskrit, English, Hindi, music, etc. To express what they have learnt here, a Sanskrit Day program was presented before Swamishri. Various scriptures and books in Sanskrit were arranged before the deities in the mandir shrines. During Swamishri's puja various Sanskrit bhajans and stotras were sung by sadhus.
After his puja, Swamishri performed pujan of the kalashas to be placed in the foundation-stone laying ceremony for the shikharbaddh mandir in Jaipur, Rajasthan.
Swamishri performed pujan of bricks to be laid in the foundation of hari mandirs in the villages of Khambha, Godhavata and Muldhara.
More than 600 devotees from Himmatnagar and Amdavad had come to celebrate the silver jubilee of Satsang in Himmatnagar.

At 6.30 pm Swamishri arrived in the silver jubilee assembly. The devotees honoured Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Swamishri. Finally, Swamishri appreciated the efforts of Yogiji Maharaj, sadhus and devotees in establishing and spreading Satsang in the Sabakantha district. Swamishri added, “By offering such bhakti, God is pleased. It is God who has given everything to us, therefore we must also give to him. When one offers heartfully and with devotion even a leaf, flower or water then God is pleased. Bhakti means to remain steadfast in God’s refuge no matter whether happiness or misery comes one’s way.”

To commemorate the 26th patostav (inauguration anniversary) of Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir, a mahapuja was held in the morning. By the time Swamishri arrived the mahapuja rituals were completed and an annakut had been arranged before the murti of Shastriji Maharaj. Swamishri performed the patotsav arti and offered mantra pushpanjali and prayers.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti for the murtis of BAPS hari mandir in Nayka. Thereafter he blessed the devotees.

BSF Squadron Leader Pramodji had come especially for darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. At the time of the terrorist attack on Akshardham he was the BSF leader, and since then his affection for Swamishri had steadily grown. Now he had been given responsibility in Srinagar. He had come here wishing to receive Swamishri's blessings before going to that sensitive area. He has received medals from the President about three times for his bravery.

Today he said, "I have received many awards from the hands of the President, but today I have come to receive the true award, your blessings." Having said this, he took vartman (the initiation vows) from Swamishri.

Dhyeyanishth Swami had come from Delhi for darshan. He looks after many departments at Akshardham in Delhi. In this context Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "This Dhyeyanishth runs everything, one never feels any tension."
Dhyeyanishth Swami said, "We ourselves do not even know how it gets done! You do everything."
Swamishri said, "What do we know? Shriji Maharaj does everything."

In the evening, after getting ready, Pramukh Swami Maharaj began reading letters. He had a cold, so he also had to take steam. When the steam machine was set up, Swamishri said to Dharmacharan Swami, "You read the letters."
He began reading the letters and Swamishri gave the replies. In this way, Swamishri did one task while doing another.
A devotee told Pramukh Swami Maharaj on the phone that his son studies well, but when depression comes over him he feels that he will not be able to study properly.
Speaking with the boy on the phone, Swamishri said, "Never believe in your mind that you will not be able to study. You are sure to succeed. Pray to God. Chant 'Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan...'."
The boy said, "I do say 'Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan...', but my mind keeps wandering."
Swamishri said, "We must make the effort and never lose courage. You have studied so well, but you have fallen into a delusion. So have faith and chant God's name."
In just a few moments Swamishri resolved the boy's mental anguish that had settled in him for a long time, and all his burden was lifted. This is the magic of the company of the manifest Brahman.
